newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korea to seek strong measures to slow won's fall.
newsitem.headline: S.Korea to seek strong measures to slow won's fall.

text.p: South Korea will seek strong steps to stabilise the won against the dollar, a senior central Bank of Korea (BOK) official said on Tuesday.
The official told reporters that the dollar's surge looked extremely "abnormal" and was not at all helpful to the South Korean economy.
To stabilise the won's plunge, the monetary authority will take "strong measures which are different from the past".
No details were given on the substance of those measures.
Dealers said the news immediately boosted the won to 879.00 at midday after hitting new 84-month low of 887.00 earlier on Tuesday.
